subject: Retron-Eco8 fingers/palm/thumb
statement: Two 2026 structure papers on the same protein, in the same 1-374 author numbering, give mutually incompatible subdomain boundaries. Xiong 2026: fingers 41-58, palm 1-40;59-266, thumb 267-374. Ji 2026: fingers 1-100;115-167, palm 101-114;168-269, thumb 270-374. Both place YADD at 198-201.
status: UNRESOLVED - both retrieved verbatim as FULL_TEXT; this project takes no side
consequence_for_interpretation: The field has no single fingers/palm/thumb partition even for one protein. Any downstream use must name the reference it follows.

subject: HIV-1 RT p66 subdomains
statement: Secondary reviews disagree by 1-5 residues at every boundary (London 2016 fingers 1-84;119-154, palm 85-118;155-241, thumb 242-313 vs Singh and Das 2022 fingers 1-85;118-155, palm 86-117;156-236, thumb 237-318).
status: UNRESOLVED - small, but it is the canonical case
consequence_for_interpretation: Even the textbook example is not a single set of numbers. Boundary precision beyond a few residues is not available from the literature.

subject: LtrA thumb (Qu 2016)
statement: One paper carries two thumb definitions: 424-473 (initial homology model) and 391-474 (complete).
status: RECORDED - both joined and reported separately
consequence_for_interpretation: A single source can supply two answers; the 3C overlap differs (Jaccard 0.265 vs 0.444).

subject: historical reference_boundaries product
statement: Fingers and thumb are residuals of a palm-centred partition in 25/25 rows; the 5HHJ anchor is hardcoded with no recorded source; the logs carry their own disagreement warnings and gate nothing; the 5G2X palm excludes its own catalytic aspartate; the same Ec86 protein receives boundaries differing by 77 residues across entries; the anchor entry is misfamilied as a retron.
status: CONFIRMED on the files by this stage
consequence_for_interpretation: The product is not boundary truth and is reported only as its own stratum. A thumb Jaccard of 0 against it measures the residual construction, not biology.

subject: author numbering of fusion/tagged chains
statement: A literature-retrieval pass reported that 9WY8, 9HDO, 26CZ, 8BGJ carry negative author residue numbers for tag residues and that 9I2F chain A is 67 residues. Neither reproduces on the coordinate files this project uses.
consequence_for_interpretation: Literature residue numbers are never assumed to map onto a chain; each source is verified per chain by a stated-motif check, and unverified sources are not joined (6 statements excluded on this ground).

subject: origin of the labels Region X and Region Y
statement: Simon and Zimmerly 2008 attribute the X/Y labels to Lampson, Inouye and Inouye 2005; Wang 2022 attributes them to Inouye et al. 1999. Neither attributed source could be read in full text here (Karger and JBC returned 403).
status: OPEN - the naming provenance is not settled
consequence_for_interpretation: The regions are used here as operational objects with a motif-relative definition, never as historically defined intervals.

subject: the VTG triplet directs the RT to its cognate msr
statement: The VTG triplet sits at the active site (Ec86 243-245, adjacent to YADD 195-198), whereas the msr-recognition contacts reported in the same structure are thumb residues R238, Q240, S249, R257, K261, R264, H268, R298, Y302. The common phrasing fuses a catalytic-proximal motif with a separate RNA-binding surface.
consequence_for_interpretation: Region Y as a ~90 aa C-terminal element and the VTG motif are different objects. A Region-Y specificity hypothesis must be stated about the surface, not the triplet.

subject: VTG in retron RTs
statement: All six Retron-Eco8 chains carry no VTG-like triplet in the declared SB7 window, so no operational Region Y is defined for them; they nonetheless contact RNA (34-40 contacting residues per chain).
consequence_for_interpretation: The "characteristic VTG" is not universal across experimentally determined retron RTs. A motif absence is not a region absence.

subject: VTG outside retrons
statement: A VTG triplet in the SB7 window is also found in non-retron chains (three group II intron maturase chains and one UG8 chain).
consequence_for_interpretation: The motif alone does not identify a retron-specific region in this population.

subject: operational Region Y in fused chains
statement: The declared VTG-to-C-terminus rule yields 322-327 residues in the three Ec67 chains and 170-344 in four non-retron chains, against the literature's "~90 aa".
consequence_for_interpretation: Where a C-terminal accessory or fused domain exists, the operational Y interval swallows it. Region Y and "the C-terminal region" are not interchangeable.

subject: Region X interval in retrons
statement: The X interval is undefined in 13 of 21 retron chains, and scanned only in a wide window in 5 more, because the GII-centred mapper does not reach block SB2p in them (SB2p unavailable in 38 of 62 chains).
consequence_for_interpretation: Region-X statements about retrons cannot be made from this instrument. This is a statement about the frame, not about retron biology.

subject: Stage-3B evidence on retrons
statement: Every retron chain is Tier B or Tier C in Stage 3B, which closed with Tier B never opened. Comparison A therefore covers 19 Tier-A truth-bearing chains, none of them a retron.
consequence_for_interpretation: Comparison A says nothing about retron catalytic architecture. Admitting Tier-B truth labels descriptively is an operator decision.

subject: palm-like call vs catalytic site
statement: In 4 of 9 chains with a palm-like CALL the catalytic aspartates lie in a different unit (8GH6_A, 8UW3_A, 9YFD_A, and 9NL3_A where they lie in the fingers-like unit).
consequence_for_interpretation: The Stage-3A palm-like heuristic identifies a beta-sheet-rich unit, which is not always the catalytic unit. The two must not be equated.

subject: Stage-2 blocks vs structural units
statement: Blocks SB3 and SB56 are contained in the same single unit in 28/28 chains where both are contained; SB56+SB7 in 35/36. Most of the numbered series collapses into one structural unit.
consequence_for_interpretation: RT0-RT7 and contact-density units describe different scales. Neither refutes the other.

subject: mapper positive control on LtrA
statement: 3 of 143 g7a-MAPPED states disagree (states 253-255 land at author residues 247-249 instead of 297-299). 5G2X_C has an unmodelled gap 251->302; the input is the gap-collapsed modelled sequence, so the alignment shifts at that boundary.
status: EXPLAINED - control passed at 140/143 = 0.979 against the declared 0.95
consequence_for_interpretation: Structure-derived sequences are not construct sequences. State-to-residue placements adjacent to unmodelled gaps carry this uncertainty.

subject: internal insertions
statement: No gap between consecutive mapped anchors reaches the declared 20-residue excess (maximum 19), yet the instrument's own insertion counts reach 774 residues in a single run (9YFD_A; median maximum run 108 over mapped chains). The gap measure is blind wherever the anchors are deleted.
status: MEASURED - both numbers reported, neither alone
consequence_for_interpretation: A "no insertions detected" statement from the gap rule would be false. Insertion architecture needs a measure that does not depend on anchors being mapped.

subject: terminal extensions
statement: Residues outside the mapped anchor span are only extensions where the anchor series reached both ends; it did so in 20 of 62 chains. In 39 chains the series is truncated, mostly because the GII-centred frame does not commit N-terminally.
consequence_for_interpretation: Extension statistics are reported only over the 20 complete-series chains. The truncated cases are unseen RT sequence, not architecture.

subject: chains the mapper cannot place
statement: 5VBS_A (246 aa) and 8BGJ_A (203 aa) fall below the instrument's registered 250-residue minimum; 1RTD_A returns ABSTAIN (no qualifying domain).
consequence_for_interpretation: Three chains carry no Stage-2 evidence in 3C. Abstention is not absence.

subject: Stage-3B bundles
statement: cat3b_g1 and cat3b_g2 seal three __pycache__/*.pyc paths in OUTPUTS.tsv that git never tracked, contrary to BS-16.
status: RECORDED - no result of those bundles is affected
consequence_for_interpretation: A fresh clone cannot satisfy those three hash rows. Every scientific file of both bundles matched.

subject: 9L7P and the St85/Ec78 label
statement: The Stage-3A register records 9L7P_E as RVT-Retrons (St85) with accession A0AAW7FAU3; a retrieval pass reported "St85" as a family label for the Ec78 system (Q46666). The two accessions differ.
consequence_for_interpretation: Family labels are metadata and are never used as evidence in this stage; the disagreement is carried forward.

subject: literature boundaries not retrievable
statement: Of the sources sought, publisher sites returned 403 or paywalls for Ec86 (7V9U/7V9X/7XJG/8QBK-M), 9LPA, 24NC, 26CZ, 9IOA, 9WY8, 9K6G, 9LJE; MMLV RT has no obtainable numbered boundary; and for most proteins the canonical subdomains appear only as unnumbered figure schematics.
consequence_for_interpretation: Comparison C rests on 17 usable boundary statements over 8 chains. It is a sample of the literature, not a census of it.

subject: Comparison A concordance
statement: Stage 3A was blind to Stage 3B by design, but both describe the same fold core, and the catalytic site is inside the RT core by definition. The size-expected baseline (median 0.309 of modelled residues in the target unit) prices how much of the agreement is structural inevitability.
consequence_for_interpretation: Site-in-unit concordance is a description, not a validation of either instrument.
